test_title: PYST 30: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'FANGLE' is written as 'UZMTOV' and 'GUNTER' is written as "TFMGVI". How will 'ISOLATE' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/UzpgS9NWnf3i3x7-X6F1K8riC-BtTyseCvp5ikq3b-3IJaPn-Q8p_YO18gfwmnKgtKmdsx0uuo2wEz_vY84_2ECBPeIk9WkYV_7XOr1-I441kx3rQvZOZUu6OVklF_TEPUMkigWQ6FomPq-cVrVzxd2Aj37hdXYq490HjkFKWdT8PZu5l90gvfZmCUHB] 

'FANGLE' is written as 'UZMTOV' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1d4aad3e4ae70b95b83e2728c97bc264e323880cce1f8c2fc8ee445fcdefff9.png] 

And,

'GUNTER' is written as "TFMGVI"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e13184605212fc5c4afb10aed69c7c1fec6679fb73daacfe304708502626f757.png] 

Similarly,

'ISOLATE' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c9653dbe5aae6bcd7980dde28efa0b3618e7c06732c76c3aa8e58873e207bc1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "RHLOZGV".
